$comment: Which AnonRouter confidential routes are OFFERED, copied from the service
that decides it. Generated from config/confidential-route-policy.json in the
AnonRouter repository; do not edit by hand.
This is a CONVENIENCE, not a security control. The SDK refuses a withheld
route early so a caller gets a clear answer before spending a ticket, but it
never RELIES on this list: every route still fetches fresh evidence and every
verdict is still computed from that evidence. A route missing from this file
is not thereby trusted, and a route listed in it is not thereby verified.
An ALLOWLIST, not a denylist, and the direction is the point. A Venice
e2ee route that appears in the catalog tomorrow is withheld until
somebody measures it, rather than offered until somebody notices it is
broken. Adding a tenth route therefore fails a test instead of shipping
